attrs.label: Device Name
attrs.description: A friendly name shown in your CineFind account.

attrs.label: CineFind Pairing Code
attrs.description: Create this one-time 10-character code in CineFind Account → CineFind Bridge. It expires after 15 minutes.

attrs.label: Local Seerr URL (Optional)
attrs.description: Your local Seerr URL, for example http://192.168.178.195:5055. Leave both Seerr fields empty if unused.

attrs.label: Seerr API Key (Optional)
attrs.description: Create this key in Seerr. It stays inside this TrueNAS app and is never sent to CineFind.

attrs.label: Local Radarr URL (Optional)
attrs.description: Your local Radarr URL, for example http://192.168.178.195:7878. Used for movie requests.

attrs.label: Radarr API Key (Optional)
attrs.description: Found under Radarr Settings → General → Security. It stays local and is never sent to CineFind.

attrs.label: Local Sonarr URL (Optional)
attrs.description: Your local Sonarr URL, for example http://192.168.178.195:8989. Used for series requests.

attrs.label: Sonarr API Key (Optional)
attrs.description: Found under Sonarr Settings → General → Security. It stays local and is never sent to CineFind.

attrs.label: User ID
attrs.description: The user id that CineFind Bridge files will be owned by.

attrs.label: Group ID
attrs.description: The group id that CineFind Bridge files will be owned by.

The name of the network to join.</br>
The network must already exist.

attrs.description: Stores a revocable device token. Do not delete it unless you intend to pair again.

1.0.0.readme:
CineFind Bridge

CineFind Bridge connects CineFind to private Seerr, Radarr, and Sonarr services through an outbound-only connection.
